min_income_rule: 100% of the national minimum wage (RMMG, €920 in 2026) for the first adult, net of social security; +50% per additional adult, +30% per child/dependent
notes: Minimum wage set by Decree-Law 139/2025 of 29 December. MNE site blocks scripted clients; text read via search-indexed extract of the official page.

program_en: Residence visa for remote work ("digital nomad", D8)
min_income_rule: Average monthly income over the last 3 months of at least 4 × the Portuguese minimum monthly wage
notes: Amount derived: 4 × €920 (2026 minimum wage from MNE page). Rule text read from the Portuguese embassy checklist published via its official visa partner VFS Global.

min_income_rule: 200% of the Spanish minimum wage (SMI) per month; +75% SMI for the first family member and +25% SMI for each additional member
notes: Euro amount left null: depends on the SMI in force, which was not verified on an official page today. citizenship_years: general 10-year legal residence rule (Ministry of Justice).

min_income_rule: 400% of IPREM; +100% of IPREM for each family member in the applicant's care
notes: Fee paid via form 790 code 052 (amount not stated on page). Euro amount null: IPREM value not verified on an official page today. citizenship_years: general 10-year legal residence rule (Ministry of Justice).

min_income_rule: Substantial stable passive income in the applicant's own name, not from any employment; typically around €31,000 per person
notes: Consulates treat €31,000 as an indicative parameter ('typically'); some ask for more. Registered lease/deed for the whole stay required.

min_income_rule: At least 3 × the minimum income for exemption from healthcare cost-sharing; income must derive from the remote work
notes: €24,789 is the figure the Boston consulate states 'at the time of this writing in 2024'; other consulates publish higher current figures — check your consulate.

min_income_rule: Stable and sufficient net monthly income of at least €3,500 after taxes and contributions
notes: Scheme capped at 500 permits (official page). Employer must be registered abroad / clients abroad.

program_en: Immigration permit Category F (permanent residence, own income)
min_income_rule: Secured annual income from abroad of at least €9,568.17 plus €4,613.22 per dependent; no work or business in Cyprus
pr_path: Is itself a permanent residence (immigration) permit

min_income_rule: Gross annual salary ≥ €50,700 (2026); ≥ €45,934.20 for shortage occupations with Federal Employment Agency approval; recognised degree + job offer ≥ 6 months
pr_path: Settlement permit after 27 months of Blue Card employment (21 months with B1 German)
notes: Thresholds published annually by the Federal Ministry of the Interior. citizenship_years: general naturalisation entitlement after 5 years of lawful residence (BMI; B1 German among other conditions).

min_income_rule: Proof of means of subsistence, e.g. salary/employment contract/pension, OR a balance in a Serbian bank account equal to the Serbian minimum salary for the year of application, OR a guarantee
notes: Government rulebook (Ministry of Interior) on temporary residence documentation. Fee amount not verified on an official page today.

program_en: Visa-free stay for one full year (Ordinance No. 255)
permit_duration: Up to one full year without a visa (citizens of listed countries, incl. the Russian Federation)
notes: Not a residence permit. Russian Federation appears in the annex list of the official ordinance.

min_income_rule: Last-3-month bank statement(s) with minimum balance of 500,000 THB (or equivalent), or sponsorship letter
application_fee: 400 USD at the Royal Thai Embassy, Washington DC (fee varies by embassy)

min_income_rule: Average personal income ≥ USD 80,000/yr in the past two years (USD 40,000–80,000 allowed with additional proof such as a master's degree); employer must be established overseas; health insurance ≥ USD 50,000 or deposit
application_fee: 50,000 THB per person per 10 years (in Thailand; may be higher abroad)
